name: Elastic Email
description: Elastic Email is a robust email marketing platform and SMTP relay service that caters to businesses and developers. It provides a suite of tools and services designed to facilitate email marketing campaigns, transactional emails, and email automation. The platform offers features like email template creation, contact list management, analytics, detailed reporting, and email API functionality.
